scenes.heading: Snapshot Postgres with one command
scenes.sub: Save a database. Restore it anywhere. Move on.

scenes.text: Database snapshots used to be a chore. Now they are one command.

scenes.source:
pgsnap save devdb
pgsnap restore devdb
pgsnap restore devdb prod
scenes.caption: Save once. Restore anywhere.

scenes.label: to snapshot any database
scenes.note: Works on any size Postgres database.
